┌─ Help: Quest chains and fighting ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Quest chains                                                                                                                             │
│   Ctrl+K            the quest chain screen (or /quest); X there gives it up for good, after one question                                 │
│                                                                                                                                          │
│   A new character is offered First Steps in Thornwick: talk to the Watch greeter in Hawthorn Square, talk to your class trainer, take a  │
│   contract from the board, then go out through the east gate. It pays a small reward at the end.                                         │
│   It is optional. Nothing walks you anywhere and nothing reminds you; the Quest chain panel shows the step you are on, and the log tells │
│   you when one is done. A dismissed chain is never offered again.                                                                        │
│   Other chains ask for more than a talk: bring items to someone ("Held: 2 of 3" counts what your bags hold now), collect them, defeat a  │
│   number of creatures ("Kills: 2 of 5"), or watch a place for a time ("Watching… 12 of 20 s"). A watch starts over when you leave the    │
│   spot or a fight starts; the screen says so. The server tells the kills and the watch seconds when the step changes, not as they rise.  │
│   A step can be in another zone: the quest screen names the zone and the door to take, and how far away it is. A person who holds a      │
│   chain you cannot take yet lists it in the conversation as [locked] with the reason ("needs level 8", "finish ... first").              │
│   A quest's own item is tagged [quest] (and gold) in the bags. It cannot be sold, banked or traded, and it leaves your bags when its     │
│   quest is handed in, finished or given up; the log says so.                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                          │
│ Fighting                                                                                                                                 │
│   Tab               choose the next target                                                                                               │
│   Esc               clear the target                                                                                                     │
│   F, Space          auto-attack on or off                                                                                                │
│   Ctrl+R            auto-retaliate on or off (on, you fight back when attacked, even with no input)                                      │
│   1-8               use the ability in that slot on your target                                                                          │
│   R                 when you are dead: give up your body and wake at your bind point                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                          │
│   With no target, an attack or an ability goes to whatever is attacking you, the nearest first; the status line names the one picked. If │
│   nothing is attacking you it is refused: Tab to a target first.                                                                         │
│   A fight stops your walk: attacking, using an ability on an enemy, or something attacking you. The log says "Your walk stopped"; hold a │
│   move key to go on. To back off: F turns auto-attack off, Esc clears the target, then walk away.                                        │
